settings.question: What is Tokkey?
settings.answer: A USB-C Local AI Key with Tokkey Runtime and a local API. It works with your Mac. It is not a new computer.

settings.question: Which Macs and models are supported?
settings.answer: Apple silicon Macs. More memory lets you run larger models; the Software page has a table to check your Mac. Not every Mac or model is guaranteed.

settings.question: Does it add a GPU, NPU, or RAM?
settings.answer: No. Your Mac provides compute and working memory.

settings.question: Does Tokkey include a chat interface?
settings.answer: Yes, Private Chat. Compatible external tools can connect through the local API.

settings.question: Is Agent Hub a new Tokkey agent?
settings.answer: No. It is the entry point to connect and manage compatible agents.

settings.question: What is shared Memory?
settings.answer: Saved user context that you choose to share across tools. It is not RAM expansion.

settings.question: Does Router keep every request local?
settings.answer: No. Router lets you choose between local and cloud, and shows the model, shared excerpt and expected cost first.

settings.question: Can a task continue with the lid closed?
settings.answer: On supported configurations, yes. Photos are not proof.

settings.question: Do I need the internet?
settings.answer: Downloads, updates and cloud tasks need a connection. Installed local models work locally.

settings.question: What do the performance numbers mean?
settings.answer: Claims in the supplied artwork are not yet matched to reports. Treat them as placeholders until evidence is published.

settings.question: How much will it cost?
settings.answer: The planned one-time launch price is $129. Final pricing, availability and terms will be confirmed before orders open.
